result.one_liner: Aircall is a cloud-based communications platform providing voice calling, SMS messaging, and conversation intelligence for business integrations.

evidence.quote: OAuth is mainly for Technology Partners building apps for multiple Aircall customers to be listed on the Aircall App Marketplace, while Basic Auth is for Aircall customers
To generate an API key, go to the Aircall Dashboard > Integrations > API keys, click Generate an API key
there is no self-serve OAuth registration, and partners building marketplace apps must contact marketplace@aircall.io
Aircall's API includes over 40 endpoints, but you'll typically use only 4-6 for most integrations
API pricing and plan-gating are opaque, and while Essentials lists 'API access' as a feature, Aircall does not state whether any endpoints are gated behind higher tiers

result.notes: Self-serve basic auth credentials available from dashboard. OAuth for marketplace partners requires contacting Aircall. Rate limited to 120 requests/minute per company. Free tier mentioned but plan-gating details are undocumented.
